records.jp: ふわぁ～……よく寝たあ……
records.en_original: Ahhh... I haven't slept that well in a while.
records.en: Yaaawn... I slept well...

records.jp: んっ？　なんだろ、この手紙……
records.en_original: Hm? What's this? A letter?
records.en: Hm? What is this letter...?

records.jp: 星崎愛央様へ……？<CR>私宛みたいだけど、誰からだろう？
records.en_original: To Ao Hoshizaki...? I wonder who it's from?
records.en: To Hoshizaki Ao-sama...?<CR>It seems to be addressed to me, but who sent it?

records.jp: 裏に差出人の名前が書いてある……<CR>ええと、これは……
records.en_original: Oh, there's a name written on the back. Let's see...
records.en: Oh, there's a name written on<CR>the back. Let's see...

records.jp: こころからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Kokoro.
records.en: It is from Kokoro...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: あっ、いたいた！　こころー！
records.en_original: There she is! Hey, Kokoro!
records.en: Ah, there she is! Kokoro!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？　どうしたのー？
records.en_original: Ao? What is it?
records.en: Ao-chan? What is it?

records.jp: こころ、手紙くれたよね？<CR>……急に手紙なんて、どうしたの？
records.en_original: I got your letter, but... I was just wondering if there was a reason you wrote a letter?
records.en: Kokoro, you sent me a letter, right?<CR>...Why a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー……<CR>何かあったわけじゃないんだけどね
records.en_original: Mm... No, not particularly.
records.en: Mm...<CR>No, not particularly.

records.jp: ここに来てから、自分の文字で<CR>誰かに気持ちを伝えたことないなーって思って
records.en_original: I just thought that I hadn't told anybody how I felt in writing since I've been here.
records.en: I realized I had never conveyed my feelings to anyone<CR>in my own handwriting since coming here.

records.jp: そう言われてみると……私もないな
records.en_original: Come to think of it, neither have I.
records.en: Now that you mention it... neither have I.

records.jp: うん、だからね。伝えたくなっちゃったの。<CR>愛央ちゃんに、わたしの気持ちを
records.en_original: Yeah. So I just felt like sharing my feelings with you in writing.
records.en: Yeah, so I wanted to tell you.<CR>My feelings for you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: にしたって、これは褒めすぎだよ。<CR>私に会えてよかったって、大げさすぎない？
records.en_original: Still, it was a pretty sentimental letter. Do you really feel that lucky to have met me?
records.en: Even so, you praised me too much.<CR>Isn't saying you are glad you met me a bit exaggerated?

records.jp: じゃあ、わたしが嘘を書いたってこと？
records.en_original: Are you saying I lied?
records.en: Then are you saying I wrote a lie?

records.jp: ……うっ！<CR>そうは、思わないけど……
records.en_original: Um! W-well, no, but...
records.en: ...Ugh!<CR>I don't think you lied, but...

records.jp: ふふっ、でしょ？
records.en_original: Hehe, I didn't think so.
records.en: Hehe, right?

records.jp: ……ねえ、こころ。<CR>なんで今、手紙を書こうと思ったの？
records.en_original: But, Kokoro, why did you suddenly feel like writing a letter now?
records.en: ...Hey, Kokoro.<CR>Why did you decide to write a letter now?

records.jp: ……大好きな人との別れは、いつだって突然だから。<CR>もう二度と、後悔したくないって思ったの
records.en_original: Well... Being separated from those you care about always happens suddenly. I just don't want to have any regrets.
records.en: ...Because separation from someone you love always comes suddenly.<CR>I never want to regret it again.

records.jp: この世界が、これからどうなるか分からない。<CR>だから……今のうちに、愛央ちゃんに伝えたかった
records.en_original: We don't know what will become of this world. So...I wanted to tell you before anything happens.
records.en: We don't know what will happen to this world.<CR>So... I wanted to tell you now, Ao-chan.

records.jp: たくさんのありがとうと、<CR>たくさんの大好きを……
records.en_original: I wanted to say thank you, and that I love you.
records.en: So many thank-yous,<CR>and so much love...

records.jp: そっか……<CR>じゃあ、私もこころに手紙を書くよ
records.en_original: I see... Then I'll write you one too.
records.en: I see...<CR>Then I'll write you one too.

records.jp: えっ、愛央ちゃんも？
records.en_original: What? You will?
records.en: Huh, Ao-chan will too?

records.jp: うん。私も、こころに伝えたいこといっぱいあるし
records.en_original: Yeah. I have lots that I want to tell you too, Kokoro.
records.en: Yeah. I have so much I want to tell Kokoro too.

records.jp: わたしに伝えたいことって何？
records.en_original: Like what?
records.en: What do you want to tell me?

records.jp: それは、今言えないよ！<CR>手紙を読んでのお楽しみ！
records.en_original: I can't tell you now! You'll have to read the letter to find out!
records.en: I can't say it now!<CR>You'll have to wait and enjoy reading the letter!

records.jp: あ、そっかー！
records.en_original: Oh, of course!
records.en: Ah, of course!

records.jp: ふふっ！<CR>愛央ちゃんからの手紙、早く来ないかなあ
records.en_original: Hehe! I can't wait to read it.
records.en: Hehe!<CR>I can't wait for Ao-chan's letter.

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、こころの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Kokoro herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Kokoro's feelings!)

records.jp: え。勇希からだ
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Yuki.
records.en: Huh. It is from Yuki.

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: 勇希！　手紙、ありがと。めっちゃ嬉しかったよ！<CR>……てゆか、なんで手紙？
records.en_original: Yuki! Thanks for the letter. It was really nice! But...why a letter?
records.en: Yuki! Thanks for the letter. It made me really happy!<CR>...But why a letter?

records.jp: う……あたし、本音言うの苦手だからさ、<CR>口で伝えたら、絶対ごまかしちゃうかなって
records.en_original: Well... I'm not very good at expressing my feelings. I thought I'd just mess it up if I tried to tell you those things in person.
records.en: Ugh... I'm bad at saying what I really feel,<CR>so I thought I'd definitely dodge it if I tried to say it aloud.

records.jp: でもさ……ここでの暮らしが終わる前に、<CR>今度こそちゃんと伝えなきゃって思ったんだ
records.en_original: But I just had to tell you how I feel before our time here comes to an end.
records.en: But... before our life here ends,<CR>I thought I had to tell you properly this time.

records.jp: 元の世界へ戻った時、あたしは結局<CR>生きてないかもしれない
records.en_original: I may not even be alive when we get back to our world.
records.en: When we return to our original world,<CR>I may ultimately not be alive.

records.jp: だからここでの日々は、あたしにとって<CR>これ以上無いくらいのプレゼントだったんだ
records.en_original: So the time I got to spend here was the greatest gift I could ever have asked for.
records.en: That is why the days here were<CR>the greatest present I could possibly receive.

records.jp: 勇希は元の世界でもちゃんと生きてて、<CR>伶那さんとラブラブに決まってるじゃん！
records.en_original: I have no doubt that you and Rena will be alive and well and all lovey-dovey in our world, Yuki!
records.en: Of course you'll be alive in our world too,<CR>and totally lovey-dovey with Rena-san!

records.jp: 愛央はそうやって、絶対あたしのこと諦めて<CR>くれなかった。だからさ……
records.en_original: You've always had faith in me, Ao. That's why...
records.en: Ao, you absolutely refused to give up on me.<CR>And because of that...

records.jp: あたしは元の世界でも生きてる可能性、<CR>絶対に諦めないし、伶那のことも泣かせない
records.en_original: That's why I won't give up hope that I'm alive in our world either. I'll never make Rena cry.
records.en: I won't give up on the possibility that I'm alive in our world either,<CR>and I won't make Rena cry.

records.jp: 愛央からは、あたしがそんな風に考えられる希望を、<CR>ずっと貰ってきたんだ
records.en_original: Ao, you've given me the hope I need to be able to think that way. From the beginning till now.
records.en: Ao, you have always given me the hope<CR>that lets me think that way.

records.jp: だから……<CR>ありがとうって、ちゃんと言いたかった
records.en_original: So...I wanted to tell you just how much I appreciate you.
records.en: So...<CR>I wanted to properly say thank you.

records.jp: あたし、ここでの日々や、みんなのこと……<CR>絶対に忘れない
records.en_original: I will never forget the days I've spent here with all of you.
records.en: The days here, and everyone...<CR>I will never forget any of it.

records.jp: あたしが生きてる未来なんて奇跡があるなら、<CR>そんな奇跡だってあっていいと思うし
records.en_original: And if by some miracle there's a future in which I'm still alive, then I guess it's meant to be.
records.en: If there can be a miracle where I have a future in which I'm alive,<CR>I think a miracle like that can exist too.

records.jp: うん。私もそう思う
records.en_original: Yeah. I think so too.
records.en: Yeah. I think so too.

records.jp: だからさ……元の世界でも、また一緒に遊ぼう！
records.en_original: So, let's hang out in our world when we get back!
records.en: So... let us play together again in our original world!

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、勇希の気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Yuki herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Yuki's feelings!)

records.jp: 伶那さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Rena.
records.en: It is from Rena-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: 伶那さん発見！
records.en_original: Rena! Found you!
records.en: Rena-san spotted!

records.jp: うわ、星崎さん
records.en_original: Uh, hi, Hoshizaki.
records.en: Ugh, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: そ、そんな嫌そうな顔しなくても。<CR>お手紙の伶那さんは素直だったのに！
records.en_original: Wh-why the face? You were so affectionate in the letter!
records.en: Y-you don't have to look so unhappy.<CR>You were so honest in your letter, Rena-san!

records.jp: ……あーあ。<CR>だから会いたくなかったの
records.en_original: Yeah... That's kind of why I didn't want to see you.
records.en: Yeah... That's kind of<CR>why I didn't want to see you.

records.jp: そういうの、ガラじゃないってのに。<CR>ああもう、なんで手紙にしちゃったんだろ
records.en_original: That kind of thing is just not my style. Ugh, why did I do that?
records.en: That kind of thing is just not<CR>my style. Ugh, why did I do that?

records.jp: ……えへへ
records.en_original: Hehehe.
records.en: ...Ehehe.

records.jp: は？　何笑ってるの？
records.en_original: Huh? What's so funny?
records.en: Huh? Why are you laughing?

records.jp: いや、だって伶那さん、<CR>気持ちを手紙にしたことは後悔してるのに……
records.en_original: Because you're acting like you regret sending me that letter, but...
records.en: But Rena-san, even though you regret<CR>putting your feelings into a letter...

records.jp: 手紙に書かれてた気持ちについては<CR>否定しないんだなあって思ったら……ね？
records.en_original: You're not actually denying anything you wrote in it.
records.en: you are not denying the feelings written in it.<CR>When I realized that... you know?

records.jp: にやつかないで、ムカつく
records.en_original: You're so annoying. Wipe that smile off your face.
records.en: Do not grin. It is annoying.

records.jp: いや、それは無理でしょ。<CR>こんなの、嬉しくてにやけるの止まんないよ！
records.en_original: I can't. This is literally the happiest I've ever been!
records.en: No, that's impossible.<CR>I'm so happy I can't stop grinning!

records.jp: ……はあ。<CR>星崎さんって、最後まで締まらないよね
records.en_original: *Sigh* That's you, Hoshizaki. Cheeky to the bitter end.
records.en: ...Haaah.<CR>Hoshizaki-san, you really never manage to end things neatly, do you?

records.jp: でも……
records.en_original: But...
records.en: But...

records.jp: 今までずっと一緒だったんだから、分かるでしょ？<CR>私、こんなことで嘘はつかないよ
records.en_original: I think we've spent enough time together that I'm sure you know I wouldn't lie about such things.
records.en: We've been together all this time, so you know, right?<CR>I don't lie about things like this.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、伶那さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Rena herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Rena-san's feelings!)

records.jp: 日菜子さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Hinako.
records.en: It is from Hinako-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: ひーなーこーさーーーん！
records.en_original: HINAKOOOOO!
records.en: Hiiinaakooo-saaaan!

records.jp: 愛央ったら、<CR>そんなに大声出さなくても、聞こえてるよ？
records.en_original: Whoa, Ao, you don't have to yell.
records.en: Ao, you don't have to shout that loudly.<CR>I can hear you, you know?

records.jp: あは、だよねえ。……って、そうじゃなくて！<CR>日菜子さん、この手紙はどうしたの？
records.en_original: Hehe, I know. Anyway, what's with this letter?
records.en: Ahaha, right. ...Wait, that's not the point!<CR>Hinako-san, what is this letter about?

records.jp: どうしたの、って……読んだままだよ。<CR>愛央に、ちゃんとお礼を言っておきたくて
records.en_original: What do you mean? It's exactly as I wrote. I just wanted to thank you properly.
records.en: What do you mean? It's exactly as I wrote.<CR>I just wanted to thank you properly.

records.jp: 愛央は私に、かけがえのないものをくれた。<CR>なんでもない、友達との毎日を
records.en_original: You've given me something irreplaceable: an ordinary life with friends.
records.en: Ao, you gave me something irreplaceable.<CR>Ordinary days spent with friends.

records.jp: 日菜子さん……
records.en_original: Hinako...
records.en: Hinako-san...

records.jp: （……その日々が、もうすぐ消えちゃうんだ）
records.en_original: (I can't believe those days are coming to an end...)
records.en: (...Those days will disappear soon.)

records.jp: ねえ愛央、そんな顔しないでよ
records.en_original: Aww, don't look so sad, Ao.
records.en: Hey, Ao, do not make that face.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: ここでの記憶は、消えるかもしれない。<CR>けど……もしかして、もしかしてだよ？
records.en_original: Our memories of these days might disappear, but maybe...just maybe...
records.en: Our memories here may disappear.<CR>But... what if, just what if?

records.jp: またどこかで出会えたら、<CR>私はきっと愛央のことを思い出す
records.en_original: If we meet again somewhere, my memories of you will come back to me.
records.en: If we meet somewhere again,<CR>I am sure I will remember you, Ao.

records.jp: ユズやライムのこと、<CR>こんなことになっても思い出せたみたいに……ね
records.en_original: Just like how I was able to remember Yuzu and Lime.
records.en: Just like I was able to remember Yuzu and Lime<CR>even after everything that happened...

records.jp: だから愛央も、<CR>そのときはきっと、私のこと思い出してよね！
records.en_original: So, Ao, I hope you remember me too!
records.en: So, Ao,<CR>I hope you remember me too!

records.jp: ……うん！
records.en_original: I will!
records.en: ...Yeah!

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、日菜子さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Hinako herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Hinako-san's feelings!)

records.jp: 詩帆さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Shiho.
records.en: It is from Shiho-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: 詩帆さん！<CR>……あ、いい匂い
records.en_original: Shiho! Ooh, something smells nice.
records.en: Shiho-san!<CR>...Ah, something smells good.

records.jp: あ、星崎さん
records.en_original: Hello, Ao.
records.en: Ah, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 今コーヒーを淹れたところなんです。<CR>一緒にどうですか？
records.en_original: I just brewed some coffee. Would you like a cup?
records.en: I just finished brewing some coffee.<CR>Would you like to join me?

records.jp: わあ、ありがとう！<CR>じゃあ、一服ついでに聞いてもいい？
records.en_original: Yes, please! Can I ask you something while we drink?
records.en: Wow, thank you!<CR>Then may I ask you something while we take a break?

records.jp: なんですか？
records.en_original: What is it?
records.en: What is it?

records.jp: この手紙、どうして書いてくれたの？
records.en_original: Why did you write me this letter?
records.en: Why did you write me this letter?

records.jp: 日頃の感謝を、ちゃんと伝えたいって思ったんです。<CR>でも、「ありがとう」だけじゃ足りない気がして
records.en_original: I wanted to thank you for everything you've done, but a simple thank you felt a little lacking.
records.en: I wanted to properly express my gratitude for everything.<CR>But I felt that "thank you" alone was not enough.

records.jp: もっと多くのことを伝えようと思って手紙を書いたのに<CR>結局、ありふれた言葉しか並べられませんでした
records.en_original: I wrote a letter because there was so much I wanted to tell you, but it all came out so unoriginal.
records.en: I wrote a letter because I wanted to tell you so much more,<CR>yet in the end, I could only line up commonplace words.

records.jp: うまく伝えられなくて、ごめんなさい。<CR>でも……
records.en_original: I'm sorry I couldn't fit all my feelings into writing.
records.en: I am sorry I could not express it well.<CR>But...

records.jp: わたしの気持ち、ほんの少しでも<CR>星崎さんに伝わりましたか？
records.en_original: But...did the meaning of my message still get through to you?
records.en: Did even a little of what I feel<CR>reach you, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: ……っ、もちろんだよ！<CR>本当に、本当にありがとう！
records.en_original: Absolutely! I really, really loved it!
records.en: ...! Of course it did!<CR>Thank you, truly, truly!

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、詩帆さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Shiho herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Shiho-san's feelings!)

records.jp: きららからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Kirara.
records.en: It is from Kirara...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: あっ、いたいた！　きららー！
records.en_original: Hey there, Kirara!
records.en: Ah, there she is! Kirara!

records.jp: 愛央、来ると思っていた
records.en_original: I knew you'd come, Ao.
records.en: Ao, Kirara thought you would come.

records.jp: えっ、もしかして神の声が……
records.en_original: D-do you mean...the Divine...?
records.en: Huh? Could it be the Divine's voice...?

records.jp: 違う。手紙、置いてきたから。<CR>理由聞きに来ると思った
records.en_original: No. It's because I left you a letter. I figured you would come ask me why.
records.en: No. I left you a letter.<CR>I thought you would come ask why.

records.jp: そう、そうだよ！<CR>どうして、突然手紙なんて書いたの？
records.en_original: Yes, exactly! Why did you write me a letter out of the blue?
records.en: Yes, exactly!<CR>Why did you write me a letter out of the blue?

records.jp: きらら、神の声が聞こえなくなってから<CR>人と、上手く話せなくなった
records.en_original: I have found it difficult to communicate with others since losing the ability to hear the Divine.
records.en: Since Kirara stopped hearing the Divine's voice,<CR>Kirara has become unable to speak with people well.

records.jp: 愛央にも、言いたいこと言えてない。<CR>……だから、手紙にした
records.en_original: I haven't been able to tell you what I've wanted to. So, I wrote it.
records.en: Kirara has not said what she wants to say to Ao either.<CR>...That is why Kirara wrote a letter.

records.jp: 愛央が、目の前にいるうちに<CR>伝えておきたかったから
records.en_original: I needed to let you know while you were still here with me.
records.en: Kirara wanted to tell Ao<CR>while Ao was still standing before her.

records.jp: きららは、愛央に出会えて本当に良かった
records.en_original: I'm very happy to have met you.
records.en: Kirara is truly glad she met Ao.

records.jp: 神の声が聞こえないきららでも<CR>愛央は側にいてくれた……笑ってくれた
records.en_original: Even though I could not hear the voice of the Divine, you always stuck by me...laughed with me.
records.en: Even without the Divine's voice,<CR>Ao stayed beside Kirara... and smiled at Kirara.

records.jp: 愛央と一緒にいる時だけは<CR>きららは、きららのままでいられたのだ
records.en_original: I can only be myself when I'm with you, Ao.
records.en: Only when Kirara is together with Ao<CR>can Kirara remain as Kirara.

records.jp: ……この世界でみんなの役に立ちたいと<CR>思っていたが、今は少し違う
records.en_original: I used to think that I wanted to be useful to everybody here. But now I feel a bit different.
records.en: ...Kirara used to think she wanted<CR>to be useful to everyone in this world, but now it is a little different.

records.jp: きららは、愛央の役に立ちたい……。<CR>愛央の力になりたいのだ
records.en_original: I want to be useful to you, Ao. I want to be your strength.
records.en: Kirara wants to be useful to Ao...<CR>Kirara wants to be Ao's strength.

records.jp: ……ふふっ！
records.en_original: Hehe!
records.en: ...Hehe!

records.jp: 何がおかしい？
records.en_original: Is something funny?
records.en: What is so funny?

records.jp: だって、きらら……手紙に書いてあること<CR>そのまま口に出してるんだもん
records.en_original: Well, Kirara... You're pretty much saying everything that you wrote in the letter.
records.en: Because, Kirara... you are saying aloud<CR>exactly what you wrote in the letter.

records.jp: 話すの下手なんかじゃないよ。<CR>きららの気持ち……ちゃんと伝わったから
records.en_original: You're not bad at communicating at all. I got everything you wanted to say.
records.en: You're not bad at talking.<CR>Your feelings reached me properly, Kirara.

records.jp: ……む。そ、そうか……
records.en_original: I...uh... Good.
records.en: ...Hmph. I-I see...

records.jp: 私も、きららと同じ気持ちだよ。私も、きららの<CR>役に立てるように、もっともっと頑張るから！
records.en_original: I feel the same way, Kirara. I'll do everything I can to be helpful to you too!
records.en: I feel the same way as Kirara. I will work harder and harder<CR>so that I can be useful to Kirara too!

records.jp: うむ。きららのために精進するといい
records.en_original: V-very well. You may devote yourself to me.
records.en: Indeed. Ao should devote herself to improving for Kirara's sake.

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、きららの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Kirara herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Kirara's feelings!)

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Hiori.
records.en: It is from Hiori-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: あっ、いたいた！　陽桜莉さん！
records.en_original: There she is! Hiori!
records.en: Ah, there she is! Hiori-san!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん？　私のこと、探してたの？
records.en_original: Ao? Were you looking for me?
records.en: Ao-chan? Were you looking for me?

records.jp: うん、聞きたいことがあって。<CR>この手紙って、何？
records.en_original: Yeah, I wanted to ask you something. What's with this letter?
records.en: Yeah, there is something I wanted to ask.<CR>What is this letter?

records.jp: えっ？<CR>何って……感謝の手紙だよ？
records.en_original: What do you mean? It's a thank you letter.
records.en: Huh?<CR>What do you mean? It is a letter of thanks.

records.jp: あっ、もしかして私の気持ち<CR>上手く伝わらなかった！？
records.en_original: Oh no, did my feelings not come across well enough?!
records.en: Huh!?<CR>Did I not get my feelings across properly!?

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんありがとう！　とか、<CR>愛央ちゃん大好き！　とか……
records.en_original: Like how I'm grateful for you and how I love you and stuff...
records.en: Things like, "Thank you, Ao-chan!"<CR>and "I love you, Ao-chan!"...

records.jp: これからも、ずっとずっとお友たちでいてね！<CR>……って、伝えたかったんだけど
records.en_original: And how I want to be friends forever! ...That's what I wanted to tell you, anyway.
records.en: And, "Please stay my friend forever and ever!"<CR>...That is what I wanted to tell you.

records.jp: い、いやいや、それは伝わったよ！<CR>読んでるこっちが照れくさくなるぐらいに！
records.en_original: No, no, I did get that! You complimented me so much that it was almost embarrassing to read!
records.en: N-no, that got across!<CR>So well that reading it made me embarrassed!

records.jp: そっか……えへへ、よかった！
records.en_original: Really? Ehehe, yay!
records.en: I see... Ehehe, thank goodness!

records.jp: そういうことじゃなくて、<CR>なんで急に手紙なんて書いたのかなって
records.en_original: But that's not the point—I wanted to ask why you wrote a letter in the first place.
records.en: That isn't what I meant.<CR>I was wondering why you suddenly wrote a letter.

records.jp: んーとね……特別な方法で、愛央ちゃんに<CR>気持ちを残したいなーって思ったから、かな
records.en_original: Hmm, well... I wanted to let you know how I feel about you in a special way.
records.en: Hmm... I suppose I wanted to leave my feelings with Ao-chan<CR>in a special way.

records.jp: 手紙ってさ、相手のことを思いながら<CR>一文字一文字、書いていくでしょ？
records.en_original: Writing a letter makes you think about the person it's for as you write each word, you know?
records.en: When you write a letter, you write every single character<CR>while thinking of the person receiving it, right?

records.jp: 言葉にするよりも、フリスペで話すよりも……<CR>愛央ちゃんを考える時間は、ずっと長い
records.en_original: I can spend much more time thinking about you by writing than by talking in person or on FreeSpace.
records.en: Much longer than saying it aloud or talking on FreeSpace...<CR>I spend far more time thinking about Ao-chan.

records.jp: それってつまり、手紙には私の気持ちが<CR>ぎゅっーと詰まってるんじゃないかなって
records.en_original: Which means I can pack so many more of my feelings into a letter.
records.en: So I thought that meant a letter might be<CR>packed tightly with all of my feelings.

records.jp: ……そんな私の気持ちを、愛央ちゃんに<CR>持っていて欲しいなって思ったの
records.en_original: I wanted you to have something that represented my feelings like that.
records.en: ...And I wanted Ao-chan<CR>to keep those feelings of mine.

records.jp: でも、この手紙は……きっと……
records.en_original: But... This letter probably won't...
records.en: But this letter... surely...

records.jp: うん……きっと、手元には残らない。でも、この手紙の<CR>ことは愛央ちゃんの記憶に残るかもしれない
records.en_original: I know. It probably won't come with you when we leave. But there's a chance you'll remember it.
records.en: Yeah... It probably will not remain in your hands.<CR>But this letter might remain in your memory, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 私と過ごした、今この瞬間が……残るかもしれない
records.en_original: The memories of the time you spent with me, including this very moment, might remain.
records.en: This very moment spent with me... might remain.

records.jp: 全部、もしもの話だけど未来は分からないから。<CR>幸せな結末を、信じてもいいと思うんだ
records.en_original: I mean, it's all hypothetical, but I don't see why we can't hope for a happy ending.
records.en: They are all only possibilities, but we do not know the future.<CR>I think it is all right to believe in a happy ending.

records.jp: ……陽桜莉さん
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: ...Hiori-san.

records.jp: 私……この手紙も、陽桜莉さんの気持ちも……<CR>絶対に忘れないから！
records.en_original: I promise... I will never forget about you or this letter!
records.en: I... will never forget this letter<CR>or your feelings, Hiori-san!

records.jp: ……うん、約束だよ！
records.en_original: ...Okay! You promised!
records.en: ...Yeah, it is a promise!

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、陽桜莉さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう！）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Hiori herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Hiori-san's feelings!)

records.jp: 美弦さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Mio.
records.en: It is from Mio-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: 美弦さーん！　もー、びっくりしたよー！
records.en_original: Mio! You surprised me!
records.en: Mio-san! Geez, you surprised me!

records.jp: いきなり手紙くれたりしてさ！<CR>……すっごい嬉しかった！
records.en_original: I never expected to get a letter from you! It made me so happy!
records.en: You gave me a letter out of nowhere!<CR>...It made me so happy!

records.jp: ふふ。口で伝えるのが恥ずかしくて
records.en_original: Hehe. I was a bit too shy to say those words to your face.
records.en: Hehe. I was embarrassed to say it aloud.

records.jp: それに手紙って、書く方も言葉を丁寧に吟味しながら、<CR>心に刻むことができるでしょう？
records.en_original: Besides, with a letter, the writer can fully consider each word and inscribe them upon her heart.
records.en: Besides, when writing a letter, the writer can carefully choose<CR>each word and engrave it in her own heart, can she not?

records.jp: ……この日々も、あと少しで終わる。<CR>その時に、伝えそびれて後悔したくなかったの
records.en_original: Our days here will end very soon. I didn't want to regret not having said what I needed to say.
records.en: ...These days will end very soon.<CR>I did not want to regret failing to say it when that time came.

records.jp: 愛央。あなたのおかげで、私は陽桜莉との……<CR>いいえ、多くの絆を結びなおせた
records.en_original: Ao, it's thanks to you that I was able to connect with...not only Hiori, but with so many people.
records.en: Ao. Thanks to you, I was able to reforge my bond with Hiori...<CR>No, many different bonds.

records.jp: ……何より、あなたと過ごした時間は、<CR>私自身を見つめ直させてくれたわ
records.en_original: Above all, the time I spent with you allowed me to reevaluate myself.
records.en: ...More than anything, the time I spent with you<CR>made me look at myself again.

records.jp: 私も、美弦さんにはいろんなことを教わって……<CR>美弦さん。私、少しはマシなリーダーになれたかな？
records.en_original: I've learned a lot from you too... Mio, do you think I have become a better leader?
records.en: I learned so much from you too...<CR>Mio-san, did I become at least a slightly better leader?

records.jp: ふふ。そうね……<CR>あなたはあなた……それだけで十分なのよ
records.en_original: Hehe. Well... You are you, and I think that's more than enough.
records.en: Hehe. Let me see...<CR>You are you. That alone is enough.

records.jp: そして、私のかけがえのない友人。<CR>だから、元の世界でも――
records.en_original: And you are a good friend of mine. So, in our world...
records.en: And you are my irreplaceable friend.<CR>So, in our original world too—

records.jp: うん。きっと会えるよ。<CR>美弦さんとは、かたーい絆で結ばれてるんだから
records.en_original: Yeah. We'll meet again. You and I share a tight bond!
records.en: Yeah. I am sure we will meet.<CR>After all, Mio-san and I are bound by a rock-solid bond.

records.jp: 愛央、ありがとう
records.en_original: Thank you, Ao.
records.en: Ao, thank you.

records.jp: それはこっちこそだよ、美弦さん！
records.en_original: No, Mio, I should be thanking you!
records.en: I should be thanking you, Mio-san!

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、美弦さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Mio herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Mio-san's feelings!)

records.jp: 詩さんからだ……
records.en_original: Oh, it's from Uta.
records.en: It is from Uta-san...

records.jp: 手紙の内容は……日頃の感謝っぽいけど<CR>なんで急に手紙なんだろう？
records.en_original: This looks like a thank you letter, but...why a letter?
records.en: The letter seems to be thanking me for everything,<CR>but why send a letter all of a sudden?

records.jp: んー！<CR>気になるから直接、聞きに行こう！
records.en_original: Oh! I can just go ask her in person!
records.en: Hmm!<CR>I'm curious, so I'll ask her directly!

records.jp: 詩さーん！　手紙くれたよね？<CR>すっごい嬉しい！　ありがとう！
records.en_original: Hey, Uta! You wrote me a letter, didn't you? I'm so happy! Thank you!
records.en: Uta-san! You sent me a letter, right?<CR>It made me so happy! Thank you!

records.jp: でも……いきなりどうして？
records.en_original: But...why a letter all of a sudden?
records.en: But... why so suddenly?

records.jp: 私が忘れないため……<CR>星崎さんに、忘れないでもらうため
records.en_original: So that neither you nor I would forget.
records.en: So that I will not forget...<CR>and so that Hoshizaki-san will not forget.

records.jp: 星崎さんから、ずっと勇気をもらっていたこと。<CR>おかげで私は、過去の私と向き合えたこと
records.en_original: I was only able to face who I used to be thanks to the courage you gave me.
records.en: That Hoshizaki-san always gave me courage.<CR>That thanks to you, I could face my past self.

records.jp: 私がどんな人間でも、星崎さんは私に笑いかけて、<CR>そして、みなさんとの絆をくれたんです
records.en_original: Regardless of the kind of person I was, you smiled upon me, and helped me bond with everybody else.
records.en: No matter what sort of person I was, Hoshizaki-san smiled at me<CR>and gave me bonds with everyone.

records.jp: 私、そんなに凄いことってしたかな……。<CR>私はただ、詩さんと仲良くなりたかっただけだよ？
records.en_original: Did I really do all that? I just wanted to be friends with you.
records.en: Did I really do anything so amazing...?<CR>I only wanted to become friends with you, Uta-san.

records.jp: それが私にとって、どんなに凄いことなのか、<CR>分かってくれなくてもいいんです
records.en_original: It is okay that you do not understand how profound that is to me.
records.en: You do not have to understand<CR>how extraordinary that was to me.

records.jp: ……あなたと出会えてよかった
records.en_original: I am happy to have met you.
records.en: ...I am glad I met you.

records.jp: たとえ全てを忘れることがあっても、この気持ちだけは<CR>魂に刻みたい……そして、あなたに伝えたい
records.en_original: Even if I were to forget everything else, I want this feeling to be etched onto my soul... And I want you to know it.
records.en: Even if I forget everything, I want to engrave only this feeling<CR>into my soul... and tell it to you.

records.jp: そう思って、あなたに手紙を書いたんです
records.en_original: So, that is why I wrote you a letter.
records.en: That is why I wrote you a letter.

records.jp: 詩さん……私も、詩さんと出会えて嬉しかったよ。<CR>ううん。これからだって一緒に笑おうよ
records.en_original: Uta... I'm glad to have met you too. We'll have plenty more good times together from here on!
records.en: Uta-san... I am glad I met you too.<CR>No. Let us keep laughing together from now on.

records.jp: はい。きっと、これからも
records.en_original: Yes. I hope we will.
records.en: Yes. Surely, from now on too.

records.jp: （……突然、手紙なんてびっくりしたけど……<CR>この手紙、詩さんの気持ちごと大事にしよう）
records.en_original: (I was surprised to get a letter out of nowhere, but I'll cherish it as if it were Uta herself!)
records.en: (A letter out of nowhere surprised me, but...<CR>I will cherish this letter together with all of Uta-san's feelings!)
